note: Crash-shaped issue: the symptom is that dxc fails internally in HLMatrixLower's HLMatrixSubscriptUseReplacer. Scored with triage.py's is_internal_failure(), never with a predicate written against this crash's own message. Both halves of that function are load-bearing here, and manual-case-predicate-counterfactual.txt measures it: the exit-status half classifies v1.4.1907/v1.5.2010 (0xC0000005, stderr completely empty), v1.6.2104 (0xE0000002) and v1.6.2106/v1.6.2112 (0x80AA001C = DXC_E_LLVM_UNREACHABLE), while v1.7.2207 through v1.8.2407 exit 0x80004005 (E_FAIL, which is deliberately NOT in INTERNAL_STATUS because ordinary syntax errors use it) and are classified only by the build-agnostic 'UNREACHABLE executed' text marker. Status alone reports a fix at v1.7.2207; the reporter's own quoted line reports a two-release window at v1.6.2106..v1.6.2112 that does not exist. Both are false. Controls: variant-workaround-* is the reporter's stated fix (Param.Matrix[2].xxx) and must NOT match; variant-hello-anyhit-* is a feature-presence control proving a release rejecting the repro still compiles lib_6_3 anyhit shaders; variant-nodup-swizzle-* / variant-dup-swizzle2-* isolate ContainsDuplicateElements() as the discriminator; variant-cs-subscript-* carries the identical subscript in a compute shader.
